query: Trump job approval poll independents drop

results.content:
Historically, the economy has been Trump's strongest political issue. The latest polling suggests that advantage has weakened substantially among independents.

The YouGov/Economist series shows Trump's net economic approval among independents dropping from positive 8 points in January 2025 to negative 50 points by July 2026—a 58-point swing. [...] In the YouGov/Economist data, Trump's net approval among independents—a figure calculated by subtracting disapproval from approval—stood at negative 4 points in January 2025. By July 2026 it had fallen to negative 50 points.

Fox News polling shows a similar pattern.

results.content:
The decrease in Trump’s approval ratings during his current administration has primarily come from Republicans and Republican-leaning independents: Today, 69% approve of the way Trump is handling his job as president, down from 84% in February 2025.

There has been a more modest decline among Democrats and Democratic leaners, who largely disapproved of Trump from his early days in office: Just 6% now rate Trump’s job performance positively, down from 10% in February 2025. [...] Trump’s approval rating over the course of his second term so far has averaged 84% among Republicans and 6% among Democrats – a 78 percentage point gap. results.title: Trump’s job approval rating is low by historical standards

results.content:
President Donald Trump in the Oval Office of the White House in Washington, DC, on July 29, 2026.

A new Economist/YouGov poll released July 28 found Trump has a record-low net job approval of -28, with 34% of Americans approving of his performance and 62% disapproving. He’s 53 points underwater among independents, and a whopping 43% of Republicans who identify as “non-MAGA” disapprove of him.
